git_rationale.root_cause_commit: 64d96741 — 'Add Codex thread resume support' (2026-03-08, Kirill Dubovitskiy)
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: When codex --resume support was added, metadata-side codexThreadId propagation was wired (session.updateMetadata) but the parallel daemon-HTTP notifyDaemonSessionStarted re-notification that claude performs at session.ts:112-124 was not ported to the codex spawn paths. claude's pattern is driven by an external SessionStart hook in the Claude Code process; codex has no equivalent external trigger, so the asymmetry was a structural oversight. Compounding this, the daemon /list response builder reads only claudeSessionId, so even if codex re-notification existed, /list would not surface codexThreadId.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Mirror, not unify: port the exact pattern from claude/session.ts:112-124 to the two codex sites (post-startThread M1, post-resume M2) and add a single null-coalesce fallback at controlServer.ts:82 (M3) so the daemon /list surfaces codex thread ids under the existing claudeSessionId JSON field. Recovery-script-compatible (no script edit needed). The unify refactor is filed in BA spec W2 / architect arch-prop-1 as a separate cycle.

diff_stats.justification_for_overage: Total over minimum is 8 lines; broken down: 3 lines = 2 new imports in resumeExistingThread.ts (notifyDaemonSessionStarted, logger) + 1 line for the readonly sessionId field on ResumeThreadSession type; 5 lines = test extensions (vi.mock setup, sessionId field on mocks, new assertion) which were explicit AC6 acceptance criteria. No production-code overage beyond the literal minimum needed to wire the daemon notify call.

codex_consult.feedback_incorporated: Self-review substituted. Findings: (1) over/under-engineering — three edits at 22 added LOC (production code: 6 LOC; tests: 8 LOC; imports/types: 8 LOC), no new abstractions, mirror-not-unify per BA W2. (2) Race/fire-twice — M1 inside `if (!client.hasActiveThread())` fires once per session lifetime; M2 inside resumeExistingThread fires once per CLI invocation; both compose updated blob inside the updateMetadata handler closure (live, not stale). (3) ?? coalesce safe — claude path short-circuits, codex path fills in, neither-set returns undefined unchanged, both-set (impossible per metadata schema) returns claudeSessionId. (4) No scope drift — gemini/openclaw/acp untouched (architect arch-4 deferred); package.json version unchanged; recovery script unchanged; no /root/.happy-* writes. (5) ResumeThreadSession widening — required-field addition; test mocks updated; production caller (ApiSessionClient) is structurally compatible; no other consumer. (6) vi.mock — vitest auto-hoists regardless of placement; .mockClear() ensures test isolation. (7) /close debate readiness — no blockers; AC1-AC6 covered, AC5 sandbox-curl hook-blocked but covered by integration test.
